mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals improved labor market conditions, which positively impacts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positively correlated with UNRATE declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in out-of-sample testing.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) crosses above 5%, it indicates monetary tightening, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS being above 5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 in monetary tightening periods.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both increase, it signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positively correlated with joint increases in HOUST and RSAFS, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in out-of-sample testing.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) during an economic expansion signals strong supply-side activity, which supports equity prices and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative despite INDPRO growth, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 during expansions.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth (GDPC1) reflects overall economic health, and positive GDP growth signals strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positively correlated with GDPC1 growth, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in out-of-sample testing.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a strong labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not positively correlated with PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in out-of-sample testing.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls, it indicates a tightening labor market and potential monetary policy constraints, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS increases and UNRATE decreases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 in monetary tightening periods.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in housing starts (HOUST) during a late-cycle expansion signals reduced consumer demand, which negatively impacts corporate revenues and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite HOUST slowdown, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 during late-cycle expansions.
